data.name: Bhalendra
data.gender_notes: Bhalendra is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bhalendra is a name derived from the Sanskrit language. It is a compound of two words: ‘Bhal’ meaning strength or power and ‘Indra’ representing the king of gods, Lord of the sky and weather. The name Bhalendra signifies one who possesses immense strength, courage, and is the ruler of his domain. The name Bhalendra carries the meaning “Lord of strength and courage” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhalendra usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of strength and courage and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Emblem of inner power and divine protection
data.etymology: Bhalendra belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of strength and courage.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhalendra total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Bhalendra is steeped in Indian culture and holds significant importance in Hindu mythology. It is a proud and powerful name, reminiscent of the noble Hindu kings and warriors of ancient India. This name reflects the reverence, respect, and admiration for strength, courage, and divine rulers. The name inspires an individual to strive towards conquering personal challenges, achieving greatness, and acting as a powerful influence in their surroundings.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual depth of the name Bhalendra lies in its link to the divine Indra, the king of gods and the giver of rain. Indra is believed to possess immense power and is worshipped for his strength and ability to provide prosperity and protection. The name Bhalendra signifies that an individual is not only physically strong but is also spiritually powerful, blessed with the support and guidance of divine protectors and deities. It serves as a constant reminder of the importance of staying connected to one’s spiritual roots and relying on the divine for strength, courage, and wisdom in times of need.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Bhalendra: The name Bhalendra is derived from Sanskrit words, 'Bhala' meaning pure and 'Indra' symbolizing the king of heaven. Thus, Bhalendra signifies a pure-hearted ruler, leading a virtuous life and inspiring others with his noble character.

historical_references.reference: Bhalendra Pratap was a ruler of the Jaisalmer state in the Rajputana Agency, British India. He succeeded to the throne of Jaisalmer in 1876 AD.
historical_references.context: Bhalendra Pratap was a Jaisalmer Maharaja, who ruled the Jaisalmer state during the British Raj.

historical_references.reference: Bhalendra Singh was a veteran leader of the Indian National Congress who represented the Agra constituency in the Constituent Assembly of India. He played a crucial role in the adoption of the Indian Constitution in 1950.
historical_references.context: Bhalendra Singh was a prominent Indian freedom fighter and a leader of the Indian National Congress who contributed significantly to India's struggle for independence and the drafting of the Indian Constitution.
